name: CallableHolder
docComment:
An alias-lost callable: a callable property projects as a function member
(signature fields, no `typeInfo`), and inside a union the callable branch
emits a terminal function node — the written name never recovers on
either path.

members.name: direct
members.docComment: Direct callable property — projects as a function member.

members.name: handler
members.docComment: Nullable callable — the union member stays a terminal function node.
